text:
maria: Cutting a small RC for the search hotfix (cache N+1). Need ops + QA signoff before promoting to prod. Targeting a narrow rollout in the next 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc-2026-03-21-047. Artifact: service@v1.3.7-hotfix. Can be promoted with /promote.

ethan: ran a quick smoke on staging, latency looks fine. KV cache warm suggested before canary.

priya: telemetry quick-check: staging error-rate 0.6% vs baseline 0.4%. Not blocking but keep an eye.

dave: propose narrow rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m.

maria: agree. pin artifact to cluster-A/B, leave C as fallback. I'll trigger canary once infra warms.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan saved: steps=[5,20,50,100], step_delay=10m. Command: `/promote rc-2026-03-21-047 --stage canary --traffic 5%`

priya: release-notes draft: "fix: reduce cache misses that caused N+1 backend calls under high concurrency; improves heavy-search latency"

ethan: QA smoke passed on staging. Quick command we used:```
curl -sS https://staging-api.redwood/internal/search?q=test | jq '.timings'
```

maria: infra green for KV warm. giving signoff now.

dave: oncall acked, I'll watch SLO dashboard during rollout (sheriff on deck).

deploy-bot: Promotion started by maria. Stage=canary (5%). Details: https://deploys.redwood/rc-2026-03-21-047

maria: monitoring 10m window: p50=120ms p95=420ms errors=0.4% -> within thresholds. Holding for the step.

priya: telemetry evals show no regression on curated prompts. OK to continue to 20%.

deploy-bot: Rolled to 20% after 10m. Current metrics: p95=430ms, errors=0.45%.

dave: looks stable. will proceed to 50% in 15m if no flash alerts. rollback criteria unchanged.

maria: proceeding to promote to prod (50%) if no alerts. Command: `/promote rc-2026-03-21-047 --to prod`

deploy-bot: Promotion executed to 50% then staged to 100% over configured window. Final artifact pinned: service@v1.3.7-hotfix -> clusters A,B (C fallback). Release notes published: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-21-rc-hotfix

ethan: :tada: Thanks team. Marking this thread closed and updating changelog.
